outcome: Postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) (>500 mL within 24 h after vaginal delivery or >1000 mL within 24 h after cesarean section)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 4796 pregnant women with gestational age 328 weeks who were admitted to hospitals in Tibet between December 2010 and December 2016.
finding: Maternal age ≥35, history of preterm birth, cesarean section, newborn weight >4 kg, and neonatal asphyxia were identified as significant risk factors for PPH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with a higher risk for PPH (OR=6.69; 95% CI, 4.30-10.40; P<0.001).
